mapper.select: select t.type_id as typeId, t.type_name as typeName, count(a.asset_id) as totalEquipment, sum(case when a.offline_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as onlineEquipment from equipment_type t left join equipment_assets a on a.type_id = t.type_id and a.status = '1' where t.type_id in (145, 115, 147, 148) group by t.type_id, t.type_name order by t.type_id
